transcript: Last night my friend AJ and I went to see Sean Hayes starring in a new play on Broadway called Goodnight Oscar. It's a fictional story about a real person named Oscar Levant who was known as a pianist, but primarily for his eccentric and witty personality. He also struggled with a lot of mental health and substance issues, and the premise of this play is that he's been granted a 4 hour pass to leave the rehabilitation center he's currently at to appear on a late night talk show. Sean Hayes is stellar in this role, and it's not surprising that the show was created with him in mind to play Oscar. He captures Oscar wit and charisma just as easily as he captures his struggles and his loneliness. The play is quite funny, but also heartbreaking and shows the darker side of fame and of being a public figure. Also, if you didn't already know, you will learn that Sean Hayes is an amazing pianist and it was such a gift to see him exemplify this with that another playable for my collection.
